references.text: The Sabbath must be kept holy, and whoever desecrates it shall die. This principle is the basis for why the wood-gatherer was brought before Moses.
The prohibition against working on the Sabbath, including lighting a fire, is the background for why the man who gathered wood was arrested.
A similar situation where a lawbreaker was brought to Moses to await the Lord's judgment.
The continuation of the account of the wood-gatherer, where he is placed in custody and then stoned according to the Lord's command.
Another case that was brought before Moses, Aaron, and the entire congregation for a decision.
The Jews persecuted Jesus because he healed on the Sabbath, which shows the strict Sabbath observance rooted in texts like this one.
